question: In May 2025, which state/UT implemented the Stage I Graded Response Action Plan related to climate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi-NCR**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP)** is a set of emergency measures implemented to curb air pollution in the **Delhi-National Capital Region (NCR)** based on the severity of the air quality.
 
• In **May 2025**, the region of **Delhi-NCR** implemented **Stage I** of this plan to address deteriorating atmospheric conditions and maintain **Air Quality Index (AQI)** levels within manageable limits.
 
• **Stage I** of **GRAP** is typically activated when the **AQI** is categorized as **'Poor'**, ranging between **201 and 300**. It involves strictly enforcing orders for stopping **construction and demolition** activities that generate dust.
 
• The implementation is overseen by the **Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)**, a statutory body established in **2021** to coordinate and oversee air quality management in the **NCR** and adjoining areas.
